verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's docs explicitly claim to catch race conditions, memory leaks, and security vulnerabilities beyond style nits, and one HN commenter corroborates this ('catches bugs that even claude code misses'), but another firsthand account directly contradicts it, saying the tool was 'mostly too verbose, catching too many false positives and never really added anything useful' — a concrete hands-on counter-example to the review-accuracy claim. Missing for 10: consistent independent benchmarking of bug-catch rate vs false-positive rate, and resolution of the conflicting hands-on reports.
